about: Website content owned by this repo. Every file under Tools/Web/site (except this file, README.md and _inserts/) is copied over the website at the same path by the deploy (GameDeployWindow step 7d). Each insert puts a snippet into a website page this repo doesn't own, between <!-- Hawkes site: <id> --> comments: right after the first match of 'after' (a regex), replacing everything up to the first match of 'until' when it is set. Re-running replaces the marked block.
